verdict.rationale: Gating inbound messages is a fair question for a self-hosted AI assistant, so the axis applies. The pack never documents sender allowlists, DM policies or mention gating on any messaging surface. Its multi-user admin controls, permissions and embedded chat widgets are adjacent access controls for the web workspace, not inbound message gating.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, inbound messages are gated — sender allowlists, DM policies, mention gating — so only people I approve can drive my assistant
